annotation.title_clean: 生物医学新技术临床研究和临床转化应用管理条例
annotation.title_en: Regulations on the Administration of Clinical Research and Clinical Translational Application of New Biomedical Technologies
annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Council of the People's Republic of China
annotation.summary_en: China State Council Decree No. 818 (adopted 12 Sept 2025, effective 1 May 2026) regulating clinical research and clinical translation of new biomedical technologies: filing with health authority, ethics and academic review, adverse-event reporting, approval of clinical translation, and heavy penalties. Not related to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Clinical research institutions must file with State Council health department within 5 working days after academic and ethics review
Records retained 30 years, permanently if offspring involved
Serious adverse reactions require suspension and ethics committee evaluation
Clinical translation approval requires proof of safety, efficacy and ethical compliance
Fines up to 10 million yuan or 20x illegal gains and lifetime bans for prohibited research
